(Caṭṭī)janārdana
son of Veṅkaṭādri an. pupil of Veṅkaṭācārya.
--C. on Bhāgavata. ref. to earlier commentators Vijayadhvaja an. Tilaka.
(of 64 Yoginīs). SB. New D.. V. iv. 82079. VI. ii. 88554.|22|153

(Cāvali)Rāma_Śāstrin
protege of Raja Simhadri Jagapati Rao of Pedapur (1853-1911 A.D.).
--Kuvalayāmoda. alaṅk. illustrations in praise of a.'s patron.
See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL.

(Carukūri)Lakṣmaṇa_Suri
alias. Lakṣmīdhara alias Rāmacandrāśrama, son of Yajñeśvara an. Sarvāmbikā, younger brother of Koṇḍa Bhaṭṭa, grandson of Timmayya Somayājin of 16th Cent. of Kāśyapa gotra, of Cerukūri family in Kṛṣṇa D.. disciple of Kṛṣṇānanda an. contemporary of Anubhavānanda (a. of C. on Śāstradīpikā, Adyar D.

). He was patronised by Tirumallarāya I. of Aravidu dynasty of Vijayanagara (1567-75). Sometimes the C. on Gītagovinda is ascribed to Tirumallarāya I.
--C. Iṣṭārthakalpavallī on Anargharāghava. See under the text.
--C. Śrutirañjanī on Gītagovinda of Jayadeva.
See under the text.

(Candragiri)Veṅkaṭācārya
father of (Śrīśaila) Veṅkaṭācārya (a. of Śṛṅgārabhūṣaṇabhāṇa, Adyar).

(Caṭṭi)Veṅkaṭādri
disciple of Veṅkaṭācārya, Ānanda Tīrtha, Jaya Tīrtha, Vijayadhvaja Tīrtha an. Narasiṃhācārya who was his paternal uncle.
-C. Sajjanahitā on Bhāgavata.
